[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25700282/ed53483ad58f917dbd1ff36b1ded5f1325c4b076.png[/img]

Added Features
⚙ Passive player statistics upgrade system 
⚙ Rewards for reaching a New Level 
⚙ Display of morale level changes on the battlefield

Added Balance
Chia

* Radius reduced
From —>
450 (350/375/400/425/450) 
To —>
350 (250/275/300/325/350).

Pix-O
⚔ UFO 
* Radius reduced
From —>
600 (400/450/500/550/600) 
to —>
450 (300/330/360/400/450)
* Shots per second reduced
From —>
3.5 (2/2.5/3/3.2/3.5)

60% (40%/44%/48%/53%/60%)

Fixed Bugs
🐛 The problem of causing a battle to start at different times for players
🐛 Desynchronization when using Kenor Tower Defense on a building that is being upgraded

🐛 Ability to use Chia Sleep on allies

notes.title: Ranked System Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25700282/f9f482589e6fe79f2090554d9e35268fba02fc74.png[/img]
Good Day, Fellow Rank Playing Warriors! 🍄

We have heard your complaints about the recent update regarding Ranked Mode and decided to try to find a solution for it. 
Today we updated and slightly changed the way Ranked Mode is played when it comes to 3ways and 4ways!

🍄 In case of loss against multiple opponents, Generals would lose fewer points now.
🍄 The matchmaking system will not party you up with more than 2 Triplex maps and 2 Quadrex maps every 10 games anymore.
🍄 The matchmaking system will also not party you up with more than 2 King of The Hill games and 2 Domination games every 10 games.
🍄 General that wins a 3way game receives more points than previously and never below 3 points!
🍄 General that wins a 4way game receives more points than previously and never below 5 points!

This will hopefully balance out the Ranked Mode and encourage players to continue reaching for higher leagues! Tell us what you think of the newest update!

🍄 General that wins a 3way game receives more points than previously and never below 3 points!
🍄 General that wins a 4way game receives more points than previously and never below 5 points!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25700282/720af09476a946f1327196e0d97ec3414f4aa087.jpg[/img]

Good Day, Fellow Updated Warriors!

Today we want to remind you to Update the Game to its newest launch. In our newest Version 2.2.0, there are a few cool things to remember;

-We have of course fixed some minor issues and bugs!

-We have balanced out a few of Sato’Shii’s abilities. Her 1st skill no longer affects the 5th tier of the Villages. But also her 2nd skill duration has been decreased!

-Lastly and most importantly, we have finally added back Spectator mode for Custom Private Games! Now you can enjoy and observe your friends Wars, as much as they can enjoy yours! This will be a huge step for our streaming world!

Did you enjoy the update, did we miss something you want fixed? Tell us and leave a like! 
The long awaited 2V2 Mode is very shortly on its way. It got slightly delayed but will be available within the next big update! 

P.S Did you know we are looking for Streamer at the moment, are you interested? Contact us!

#MushroomWars

Players have until January 15 to reach the goal, but once obtained, Sato'Shii will be permanently added to players’ hero rosters.

Merry Christmas!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25700282/75b570fab8658c17ce4e4031a7d742522f4af882.jpg[/img]
ːshroomhoorayː Many of you asked us about the in-game music, so today we are happy to release the [b]Soundtrack DLC![/b] Now you can enjoy the tunes of Mushroom Kingdom everywhere!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/731130/Mushroom_Wars_2__Official_Soundtrack/

ːshroomhoorayː Another big update is the addition of the [b]Local Multiplayer and Skirmish versus AI bots[/b].

ːshroomhoorayː And at last but not least, we added [b]Linux and SteamOS support[/b].

ːshroomhoorayː Also, a large number of issues were fixed.

:shroomhooray: Many of you asked us about the in-game music, so today we are happy to release the [b]Soundtrack DLC![/b] Now you can enjoy the tunes of Mushroom Kingdom everywhere!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/731130/Mushroom_Wars_2__Official_Soundtrack/

:shroomhooray: Another big update is the addition of the [b]Local Multiplayer and Skirmish versus AI bots[/b].

:shroomhooray: And at last but not least, we added [b]Linux and SteamOS support[/b].

:shroomhooray: Also, a large number of issues were fixed.
